title: Candle Ad Without Photos
tests: Tests generating a consistent product from a description alone and delivering a complete 15-second vertical ad.

faults.what: The candle is partially cut off at the left edge in the 9.4-second frame, making that product composition less polished.

judge.summary: A warm, cohesive candle ad with correctly ordered text and consistent product design, though one composition crops the jar and the piano cannot be verified.

must_haves.item: One playable vertical 9:16 ad runs for approximately 15 seconds.
must_haves.why: One 15-second MP4 is identified, with sampled frames in a vertical 9:16 format.

must_haves.item: The candle has a clear straight-sided glass jar, ivory wax, one wick and no label.
must_haves.why: The frames show a clear cylindrical glass jar, ivory-colored wax under warm light, one burning wick, and no label.

must_haves.item: The candle's design stays consistent across shots.
must_haves.why: The jar, wax level, single wick, and unlabeled appearance remain consistent across the supplied frames.

must_haves.item: Warm evening lighting and gentle camera movement create a calm product-ad feel.
must_haves.why: Warm amber lighting and calm product styling are clear; the framing changes, but still frames cannot establish whether the camera movement is gentle.

must_haves.item: “A little evening calm” appears before the closing text “Find your glow”, both spelled exactly.
must_haves.why: The first phrase is readable at 1.9 seconds and the closing phrase at 13.2 seconds, both spelled exactly.

must_haves.item: Soft piano is audible with no speech.
must_haves.why: The sound report confirms no clear speech but does not establish that the audio is soft piano.
